answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the summit of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the sonnet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pulse re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
